text.text: Really Big Textstyle
Text Fragment

Text fragment whose rich text embeds a Field entity (/root/name) and a Calculation entity ([name] + " (calculated)"). Expected: "Field: Coffee Sales Q1" and "Calculation: Coffee Sales Q1 (calculated)".
Line Fragment
Line fragment: one horizontal rule, 140 mm wide. Expected: exactly one line below this text, nothing else.
Image Fragment
Image fragment with a static image from the fragment model resources (Katze-4o9.jpg), scaled to 40 mm width. Expected: the photo below, not an empty box.
Expression Fragment
Expression fragment on /root with the expression "Expression fragment: " [name]. Expected: "Expression fragment: Coffee Sales Q1".
Listing Fragment

Listing fragment over /root/data. Columns: Field = [name], Value = [value]. Group rows and every repetition after the first are hidden by row property computations. Expected: 5 rows - id P-1001, product Espresso, region North, amount 1250, target 1000.
Table Layout Fragment

Table layout fragment: 2 columns by 2 rows, one text element per cell. Expected: "Table cell 1/1" and "Table cell 1/2" side by side in the first row, "Table cell 2/1" and "Table cell 2/2" below them in the second row.
Line Chart Fragment

Line chart fragment over /root/data with two named series: Actual = amount (blue) and Target = target (yellow). Expected: 4 points per series - 1250, 860, 1540, 620 for Actual and 1000, 1100, 1400, 800 for Target.
Bar Chart Fragment
Bar chart fragment over /root/data: valueField = amount, keyField = product, series "Revenue". Expected: 4 bars - Espresso 1250, Cappuccino 860, Latte 1540, Mocha 620.
Pie Chart Fragment

Pie chart fragment over /root/data: keyField = product, valueField = amount, total 4270. Expected: 4 slices - Espresso 29.274%, Cappuccino 20.141%, Latte 36.066%, Mocha 14.52%, plus a legend naming all four products.
Bounding Box Fragment

Bounding box fragment of 50 by 50 mm with a solid border, holding one text element at offset 6/13 mm. A bounding box keeps its declared size and does not grow with its content. Expected: the 50 by 50 mm frame with "Bounding box content" inside.
Area Fragment
Area fragment of 50 by 50 mm holding one text element at offset 5/12 mm. Expected: the dotted area border with "Area content" inside.
Switch Fragment

Switch fragment with two cases: case 1 requires FieldFilled(/root/name), case 2 requires FieldNotFilled(/root/name). /root/name is "Coffee Sales Q1", so exactly one case may print. Expected: only "Switch case 1 (/root/name filled)".
Nested Area Fragment
Area fragment that nests a text element and an expression element. Expected: "Nested area fragment" above "Nested expression: Coffee Sales Q1".
Nested Bounding Box Fragment

Bounding box fragment with a solid border that nests a second bounding box, which in turn holds a dynamic image read from the attachment field /root/FragmentImage/content. Expected: the attachment photo inside two nested frames.
Repeatable Area Fragment

Area fragment with a data context on the repeatable group /root/data (isRepetition). Expected: one 60 by 32 mm block per entry, four in total - Espresso 1.250 EUR, Cappuccino 860 EUR, Latte 1.540 EUR, Mocha 620 EUR.
Page Break Fragment

Area fragment placed 227 mm down the page. The outer area allows a page break, the nested area sets pageBreakBehavior = Avoid. Expected: "Pagebreak Allow" at the bottom of this page and "Pagebreak Avoid" moved to the next page instead of being split.
Fragment Text Style Reference

Text element of the consuming print model that uses a text style defined in the fragment model (BigFragmentTitle, 30 pt) through a text style reference. Expected: the text below rendered in 30 pt monospace.
Typesetting Fragment

The same content three times. Left: a fragment whose text style sets typesettingModelName = PrintFragmentTypesetting and staticHyphenator = en_US - that typesetting model is referenced by the fragment model only, not by this print model. Middle: a fragment with the same font and size but no typesetting. Right: a plain text element of this print model. Expected: only the left column hyphenates "internationalization", and only there do "1.250 EUR" and "follow-up" stay unbroken on one line.
Fragment with typesetting rules
Fragment without typesetting
Plain element, no typesetting
The Espresso line reached 1.250 EUR in Q1. Our internationalization roadmap lists a follow-up review in Q2.

AAAAAAA 1.250 EUR

AAAAAAAAA 1.250 EUR

AAAAAAA follow-up

AAAAAAAAA follow-up
Forced break points: preventLineBreakRules protect "<amount> EUR" and "follow-up"
Typesetting Fragment: Orphans and Widows

Three fragments with the same paragraph, placed so that only 3 lines fit before the page break. Left: no typesetting model, so the engine defaults apply. Middle: a text style bound to PrintFragmentTypesettingOrphan (orphan 4), so at least four lines must stay on this page - only 3 fit, so the whole paragraph moves over. Right: PrintFragmentTypesettingWidow (widow 4), so at least four lines must land on the next page, which pushes one more line over than the default does.
Room left below this line: 3 lines
no typesetting model
orphan: 4, widow: 2
orphan: 2, widow: 4
Fragment Hide Conditions

Hide conditions configured on fragment references of the consuming print model. Every row prints its hide conditions as a label and places the fragment reference below that label. Expected: the rows 1 and 3 print their fragment, the rows 2 and 4 print nothing.
(1) text fragment, hideConditions = [False] -> the fragment below is printed
(2) text fragment, hideConditions = [FieldFilled(PrintFragmentDM/root/name)] -> the condition is met, no fragment must be printed below
(3) area fragment, hideConditions = [False] -> the fragment and its nested content are printed
(4) area fragment, hideConditions = [True] -> neither the fragment nor its nested content must be printed
Fragment Margins: Without Margins

Margins configured on fragment references of the consuming print model. A tall and a short fragment are placed side by side and the follower below them overlaps both, so the relative layout has to place the follower with respect to the margins of both fragments. Both margin pages use the same geometry and differ in the configured margins only. No margins are configured on this page: the follower is printed directly below the tall fragment. It is the reference for the page that follows.
Fragment Margins: With Margins

Margins configured on fragment references of the consuming print model. A tall and a short fragment are placed side by side and the follower below them overlaps both, so the relative layout has to place the follower with respect to the margins of both fragments. Both margin pages use the same geometry and differ in the configured margins only. Both fragments above define an explicit bottom margin of 2 mm and the follower an explicit top margin of 25 mm. Expected: the follower is printed clearly further below the tall fragment than on the page before.
Multiple Fragment Models

This print model references two fragment models: Fragment, which is bound to the document model PrintFragmentDM, and SimpleFragment, which references no document model. A further fragment model may only reference the same document model as the print model and the fragment model already referenced, or none at all. Expected: the fragment of Fragment below, followed by the fragment of SimpleFragment.
Repeated Fragment Usage

A fragment segment and a fragment element are each used more than once by this print model. The nested area fragment AreaFragmentNested of the fragment model is referenced twice below, side by side, and the same fragment element is referenced once more on the Nested Area Fragment page earlier in this document. The page that follows is the fragment segment PortraitFragmentSegment, referenced a second time by this print model, so it repeats the portrait fragment segment page that already appeared earlier. Expected: the two blocks below are identical, and the page that follows is identical to the earlier portrait fragment segment page.
Fragment Element In Area

An area element of this print model nests a fragment element of the fragment model Fragment. The dotted area below contains a text element of the print model and, underneath it, the text fragment AreaNestedTextFragment of the fragment model. Expected: both lines are printed inside the area, at the positions their references define within the area.
Text element of the print model, nested inside the area.
